Dragonic Overlord
Normal Unit｜ Kagero｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[ACT](VC/RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:When its attack hits, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & discard two cards from your hand], [Stand] this unit, and it gets drive -1 until end of turn.
